I used to love it…. Okay, so this app used to be my go-to for photo editing. I previously gave it 5 stars.

However, I’m disappointed to find out that my free Bazaart premium subscription is going to expire on August, 1, 2026 to accommodate the rising costs of AI. If it’s costing so much, then remove all the generative AI tools!! the app is better without it, or less of it (though preferably none I don’t support generative AI).

To know that I will be losing access to tools that once allowed me to bring creative projects to life is disappointing enough. But to learn that it’s because Bazaart rather support an AI that generates not creates instead of supporting real human artists feels like a slap in the face. AI would be nothing without the art and images it takes from HUMAN creators (which are so often used without permission).

If Bazaart is choosing AI over human creativity, then I certainly don’t need Bazaart anymore.

Changing my rating from 5 stars to 1 star. Good buy forever after 10 years!. I downloaded Bazaart around 10 years ago and used it back when the app was still much smaller. I clearly remember being offered a “full version” purchase, and I paid for it. I don’t remember the exact price anymore, but at the time it was presented as buying access to the full app.

Now, after all these years, the developers are ending my complimentary Premium access and moving features behind a subscription, even for people who supported the app early and paid for it when it was still growing.

That feels incredibly disrespectful to long-time users. I supported this app years ago because I liked it and believed in it. Taking away features that were originally part of what I paid for is not acceptable to me.

So I’m changing my rating from 5 stars to 1 star and deleting Bazaart for good. I don’t support this kind of treatment of loyal users. Goodbye.


P.S.: give me my money back!

Used to be great, not anymore. I originally purchased Premium because Bazaart’s AI editing tools were excellent. Unfortunately, recent changes have made the app far less useful for my workflow. Images that the app previously handled without issue are now frequently rejected with the generic message, “We can’t edit this photo. Try using another one.”

I’ve tested multiple photos, screenshots, prompts, devices, and internet connections. The AI will still edit some ordinary images, but many perfectly normal photographs are now refused before the edit even begins. These are not inappropriate images, nor are they unusual file formats.

As a paying Premium customer, I subscribed specifically for the AI Add/Remove/Edit features. If the AI increasingly refuses to edit legitimate photos, then the value of the subscription is significantly reduced.

I understand the need for safeguards, but the current system appears overly restrictive or unreliable. I would like to see Bazaart restore the flexibility and functionality that made the app so useful in the first place, and provide clearer explanations when an image is rejected rather than a generic error message. Moving forward, I will no longer waste my money on a Premium membership.
